messages:
Marta: Heads-up: Lighthouse Therapeutics (ACCT LT-502) flagged INV-2026-2045 for $12,960. They emailed requesting a settlement for $9k or a 2-month payment plan. Posting thread so collections/legal see context.

Ryan: Thanks. Do we have a billing contact and PO? They referenced PO-LT-21 and said billing@lighthousetx.com is the payer.

Support-bot: Support note: usage spike on 02/05 shows 3 unusual inference bursts; ticket #4120 opened. Customer provided logs and says its unexpected.

Tess: We should avoid shadowing credits before audit. Propose hold $1,200 of the disputed usage while we audit. Offer either $9k lump-sum or a 2-payment split: 50% now, 50% in 30 days, both via ACH mandate. No suspension while on plan.

Aaron.finance: Fine with split if ACH mandate plus signed waiver for dispute. Also recommend $100 processing fee if they choose installment. If lump-sum, provide 5% early-pay discount.

Legal-bot: Counsel prefers:
```
- Settlement offer valid only if customer signs release of dispute claims related to INV-2026-2045.
- If audit finds additional valid charges, company may invoice the remainder; payment terms for remainder to be net 10.
```
Confirm before sending.

Marta: Drafting two options in DocuSign: (A) $9,000 full settlement + release, (B) 2-pay plan: 50% now ($6,480), 50% in 30 days + $100 admin fee + waiver. Sending to billing@lighthousetx.com and cc acct team.

Collections-bot: Dunning scheduled: reminder email at 1808011200. If no response by 1808013600, escalate to collections lead.

Ryan: If they accept plan, we should flag account to prevent auto-suspension and set ledger code LT-502-SP. Also set reminder for ledger reconciliation after second payment.

Tess: Audit ETA 48 hours. If audit clears the contested lines, issue credit for any overcharge within 5 business days as per policy. If audit finds them valid, include acceleration clause per legal.

Marta: Sent DocuSign and Stripe invoice link. Customer acknowledged receipt and asked for 5 business days to sign. They asked if we can auto-debit the second payment  they will provide ACH mandate.

Aaron.finance: OK. Please ensure ACH mandate is captured and store the mandate reference in AR note. If first payment fails, plan cancelled and we proceed with escalation.

Support-bot: Audit update: traces show job 12422 was triggered by a scheduled cron, not internal test. Marked for further review.

Marta: Noted. Will keep thread updated. If signed plan hits, pause dunning. If not, escalate per bot schedule. Thanks all.
